description: In 1947, Peggy transfers to Los Angeles to investigate a frozen corpse tied to Isodyne Energy. The case opens into Zero Matter, the secret Council of Nine and brilliant actress-scientist Whitney Frost; with Sousa, Jarvis and Jason Wilkes, Peggy races to stop Frost as the substance reshapes everyone it touches.

s02e01.description: Peggy is sent to Los Angeles to investigate a woman found frozen in a lake during a heat wave, leading her to Isodyne Energy and scientist Jason Wilkes.

s02e02.description: Peggy and Wilkes investigate Isodyne’s Zero Matter experiments as Whitney Frost moves to seize the mysterious substance for herself.

s02e03.description: Peggy refuses to abandon the Los Angeles case after Wilkes is blamed for the Isodyne disaster, uncovering the hidden Council of Nine behind the cover-up.

s02e04.description: As Peggy and Jarvis interrogate a Council operative, flashbacks reveal the very different paths that shaped Peggy Carter and Whitney Frost.

s02e05.description: Peggy’s team races Whitney Frost to a cache of atomic bombs needed to recreate Zero Matter, while Wilkes struggles to remain physically stable.

s02e06.description: Unable to confront Whitney herself, an injured Peggy recruits Dottie Underwood to steal a sample of Zero Matter during a Council of Nine gathering.

s02e07.description: Whitney consolidates control of the Council and kidnaps Wilkes, while Peggy and Jarvis face the personal cost of pursuing her.

s02e08.description: Peggy and Sousa bargain for Wilkes as Whitney prepares another Zero Matter experiment, drawing every faction toward the Isodyne test site.

s02e09.description: With Whitney closing in on Wilkes and Thompson pursuing his own lethal plan, Peggy tries to prevent the competing schemes from killing everyone involved.

s02e10.description: Peggy, Jarvis, Sousa, Stark and Wilkes combine their resources for a final attempt to strip Whitney Frost of Zero Matter and close the rift for good.
